Latent ability revisit — condition, suitability and uncertainty without odds

Generated 2026-09-16 22:20 by stages/t08_report.py from stage outputs; research commit 1d4bd67, reference hkjc-mod@c860064 (read-only). Plan: plans/plan-latent-ability-revisit.md.

1. Verdict

64 blocks in 15 families were engineered, canary-checked and screened under both productions (B0 calibrated softmax, P0 anchored probit link) across 10 wave(s). 0 reached production-finalist; 5 are research-survivor (G1, H2, H3, K11, O2); the rest are rejected with the mechanism recorded.

Priced in (|corr with log q| ≥ 0.3 and no incremental gain): A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, B2, C1, E1, E2, K1, M4, N2. Genuinely odds-independent and null: B1, D1, H1, H4, H5, H6, H7, H8, H9, I1, I2, I3, I4, J1, J2, J3, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, K7, K8, K9, K10, L1, L4, L5, L6, M1, M2, M3, N1, N3, N4, N5, O1, O3, O4, O5, O6, P1, P2, P4, P5. Every level of past relative performance the campaign built is a market-correlated quantity that costs the productions; the departures and the simple odds-free blocks are novel and, with the exceptions below, do not move either production.

Best screen number: H2 (horse_fresh_departure_540) -0.000489 under B0, 4/7 years, CI [-0.001423, +0.000471], correlation with log q +0.009.

The one family with a signal, and what it turned out to be. The return-state blocks are odds-independent (correlation with log q below 0.05, 100% novel against the 37) and at canonical scale sit at H2 B0 -0.000174 (5/8) / P0 -0.000144 (6/8) and H3 B0 -0.000205 (6/8) / P0 -0.000189 (5/8) — beyond one column's rent on both productions, intervals spanning zero, below the −0.0005 bar. Wave 3 tested the stated mechanism ("how a horse runs fresh matters when it is returning today") and refuted it: restricting the block to today's returners is harmful (I1 +0.000538, interval [+0.000029, +0.001104]), and the undecayed version is indistinguishable from H2 (I3 -0.000460). Whatever H2 and H3 carry acts on non-returning rows as well, and it does not sharpen.

Wave 4 tested the remaining reading — that the block encodes which freshness state is the horse's better one — by constructing it conditional on today's state (J1 +0.000717, harmful), on today's preparation stage (J2 +0.000075) and at the trainer level (J3 +0.000076). All three fail. Every sharpening of the mechanism across waves 3 and 4 fails and only a near-identical restatement (I3) reproduces H2: that is the signature of a fluctuation at the scale r20 measured for single arms (sd 0.0001–0.0002), not of a mechanism. The family keeps its rule-based research-survivor label — the canonical numbers stand — and is closed for this cycle; only a prospective test on races not yet run can separate it from noise.

A second, independent survivor from a new source. Waves 5–8 left finishing-performance history for sectional shape, margins, body weight, trainer form, soundness, workload and running-position dynamics. One block passed the pre-declared screen rule on both productions: position_gain_ewm (K11, the reference build's makes-ground state), canonical B0 -0.000181 (5/8, retention +0.52) / P0 -0.000164 (5/8, retention +0.49), correlation with log q 0.33 and with B0's own correction −0.004; feature correlation with the return-state family −0.03. Wave 8 then varied its mechanism five ways (closing-section gain, field-relative gain, gain trend, position variability, pace-conditional gain): all 5 are null or harmful, so, like the return-state family, the exact construction carries a favourable sign and no variant sharpens it. Two non-redundant research-survivors, no finalist.

Wave 9 — research-seeded. The backlog came from three research threads: an inventory of raw sources no wave or production feature uses (the stewards' running comments read as prior-start traits; sire and import type; the Conghua, trainer-change, trackwork and veterinary tables exist but only from 2019–2022, and the exceptional-factors bit and handicap columns are empty), descriptive mining of where the two survivors gain (H2 in Class 1–2 and on non-firm going; both adverse at Happy Valley), and the question of weather (no weather field exists in any data file; going is the rain proxy, rain-affected for 3.2% of runners; race-level weather cancels in a within-race head, so only a horse's own departure on such days can carry information). Two of seven blocks passed the pre-declared rule on both productions and are the most odds-independent blocks of the campaign (correlation with log q 0.05 and −0.0003, novel share 1.0): horse_wide_ewm_540, the share of prior starts run wide without cover (canonical B0 -0.000173 (6/8, retention +0.48) / P0 -0.000191 (6/8, retention +0.35), verdict research-survivor); and horse_wet_departure_540, the horse's own rain-affected form relative to its overall level, active only on wet days (canonical B0 -0.000026 (4/8, retention -1.74) / P0 -0.000014 (4/8, retention -4.43), verdict rejected). The slow-start trait, the sire and import-type priors are null or harmful, and the two survivor conditionals (H2 in top class, K11 at Sha Tin) do not beat their parents — the descriptive contrasts were fluctuations. A heat block from Hong Kong Observatory station data is designed in the wave-9 manifest and gated on the wet-going result: the gate is not met — the wet-going departure's screen gain did not carry into the full refit (negative retention), so the weather question closes with a clean null on the one runner-varying interaction the data can support.

Wave 10 — weather from Hong Kong Observatory station data. The weather review argued the gate in wave 9 was the wrong way round: a horse's wet-going form is what the market prices (going and forecast are public), while heat interacting with runner traits is the plausibly unpriced angle. Daily maximum temperature at the venue's own HKO station (Sha Tin from 1984, Happy Valley from 2008-12) and Observatory humidity were fetched by tools/fetch_hko.py; 100.0% of race days match and 30% are hot (≥ 30 °C), against 3% rain-affected going. Five runner-varying blocks: the horse's own hot-day departure (acclimation) is null-to-harmful (1/7) — heat tolerance is not an individual trait the market misses; heat × body weight, heat × layoff and the Ma et al. (2017) win-recency hazard are null; humidity_x_front (Observatory humidity × the runner's early-speed style, race-centred) passed the rule on both productions (−0.000190, 5/7, correlation with log q −0.009): on humid days the market may over-back leaders whose pace collapses (canonical B0 -0.000032 (3/8, retention -2.81) / P0 -0.000000 (3/8, retention -286.90), verdict rejected). Like the wet-going departure, its screen gain did not carry into the 38-column refit (negative retention). The weather question is therefore closed on both sides — rain through going, heat and humidity through station data — with clean nulls on every runner-varying interaction the data supports.

2. The two productions, verified

B0: 37 columns of configs/features/production.json under the calibrated softmax offset (400 rounds, seeds [7, 17, 42, 123, 256], cv 3); equal-year loss 2.028615, market 2.034567. The dual scorer reproduces the r11 canonical C exactly (max |Δ| = 0.0 on 5898 races).

P0: the anchored probit LINK on B0's own member fits (hkjcres.dual): mu = log q + c(x), p = normalise(q P1/P0), 64 Gauss-Hermite nodes, scale fitted forward per member on the prequential OOF margins over the declared ladder. report/probit-anchored.md: the link passed 5/5 gates (B - A -0.000661, 11/11 years, 5/5 seeds); native probit training gave it back (C - B +0.000354, 0/5 seeds). The plan's probit_verification module is not in this checkout; the verified link is Equal-year loss 2.028368; beats the market in 8/8 years: True. P0 − B0 = -0.000247 (6/8 years, CI [-0.000690, +0.000208]). Fitted scales [2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5], any at ladder boundary: False. Dual no-op on [2024, 2025]: B0 0.0, P0 0.0.

3. What was tried — every block, both productions

Screen: a one-parameter market-offset head softmax(log p_production + Zβ) fitted on earlier canonical years' out-of-sample production probabilities, scored on the evaluation year; L2 penalty 1e-3; missing → training mean. Controls: three within-year value permutations. Finalist rule (pre-declared): delta < 0 on ≥ 5/7 years under either production, beats the control mean, beats the declared baseline block.

4. Odds-independence evidence

A block is genuinely odds-independent only if it is weakly correlated with log q and incrementally improves B0 or P0. Correlation with log q (Pearson, mean over years), correlation with B0's own correction (log p_B0 − log q), the linear market-given-market coefficient (diagnostic), forward reconstruction of the block from the 37 (novel share = 1 − boosted R², diagnostic), and the market residual y − q sorted by the block inside the weak-market subgroups.

5. Canonical: the finalists and validation arms, refit at the incumbent's profile

Rent: r15 measured one information-free added column at +0.000062 at this profile, so an arm's delta is read against that: a favourable delta smaller in magnitude than the rent has not shown it carries anything. 8. Limitations, multiple-search accounting, prospective test

  • Multiplicity. 64 blocks × 2 productions were screened; the simultaneous max-t critical value over wave 1 is 2.81, over wave 2 2.85, over wave 3 2.45, over wave 4 2.35, over wave 5 2.83, over wave 6 2.51, over wave 7 2.52, over wave 8 2.55, over wave 9 2.66, over wave 10 2.60. No single-block interval that merely excludes zero would survive that; none did.
  • The screen is a linear head. A one-parameter multiplier cannot express an interaction the booster might find; that is why odds-independent rejections were carried to canonical as validation arms rather than trusted (section 5).
  • P0 is the anchored link, not native probit training. The plan's probit_verification module is absent from this checkout; the link is the verified object (report/probit-anchored.md). A native-probit P0 would be a different instrument.
  • History depth. Study I targets begin in 2013 and forward residuals in 2016, so F1/F2 histories are short at the left edge of the canonical years (defined shares are in the tables). Reference-engine states carry full history.
  • Every year has been development data for some campaign in this repository; the canonical years are not untouched holdouts. Nothing here is promotion-eligible; that requires a separately locked prospective shadow test.
  • Prospective test proposal. Freeze any research-survivor's exact formula and constants now (they are in the manifests), materialise it live from the same sources for the 2026-27 season, and score paired R − C under both productions on races not yet run. Only that converts a retrospective survivor into production information.

Why this cycle stops here, and what a fourth wave would need

The plan's stop rule is an empty backlog of mechanistically distinct, data-supported ideas. After three waves: (i) every level of past performance available in this repository is priced (wave 1); (ii) the odds-independent departures are null except the return-state family (waves 1-2); (iii) that family's stated mechanism was tested and refuted, and it does not sharpen (wave 3). Ideas that remain are not data-supported here: a return × recent-trial interaction is derivable from production's own bt_days_since and layoff_log (redundancy, not signal, per plan §7); trackwork and veterinary records are cohort-selected recent-era tables the build deliberately excludes; pedigree/origin and jockey booking are closed by Studies I and V. The next investment is the prospective test above or new data capture, not a 26th block.

9. Integration instructions

None: no block reached production-finalist. Nothing is to be integrated, and hkjc-mod was not written to.
